body.p: A mouse. A mouse goes down the river in a boat with the flow. While going it appeared in front of a fishermen tent. Mouse, where are you going? Land on the shore and eat! The fishermen said. I'm going downstream, I'm going downstream. What kind of fish are you eating, asked the mouse. Pikes, perches! I don't want to, I have a small throat! The mouse went further. It found one more tent. Mouse, where are you going? Land on the shore and eat! I'm going downstream, I'm going downstream. What kind of fish are you eating? White fish, peleds! I don't want to, I have a small throat! The mouse went even further. It goes, and âit found one more tent. Mouse, where are you going? Land on the shore and eat! I'm going downstream, I'm going downstream. What kind of fish are you eating? We are eating barika, we are eating sturgeon. I'll eat, I'll eat! The mouse landed on the shore and pulled its boat onto land. It eats a lot. After eating, it barely dragged its body into the boat. It went further. Its boat goes very slowly, it is carried only by the flow. It goes, and âit found one more tent. Mouse, where are you going? Land on the shore and eat! I'm going downstream, I'm going downstream. What kind of fish are you eating? Whitefish and nelmas! I'll eat, I'll eat! The mouse landed on the shore and pulled its boat onto land. The fishermen fed the mouse with different things. While the mouse was eating, the fishermen placed needles in its path. The mouse, while walking to its boat, pricked its entire belly with these needles. Mouse, what happened to you? I have died, I have died! Mouse, that's how we taught you a lesson, ha-ha, ha-ha! So you have killed me on purpose?![ShA:] My interpretation of the whole sentence is unsure. So the mouse died. They chopped up mouse's boat with an ax, and threw the dead mouse into the water. After it ate so much into its belly, the mouse's belly burst. So, there are such edacious mice! The tale is over.
